name: Nightly Visits
source:
The human Prince, Aryan, one night is awoken by a visitor sucking his dick - one he didn't even know.

Aryan was desperate for gay sex. He knew he'd do anything at this point to do something sexual with another guy, but unfortunately he didn't really have the chance to experience something like that - being royalty and all that.

One auspicious night he is surprised to wake up to the feeling of someone licking his gland. When he opened his eyes he could see that if was a guy... elf?

The Prince was accustomed used to surprises, but this one was next level - and he enjoyed every single moment of it.

Originally a [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221206050601/https://gaywriter10.itch.io/nightly-visits-twine]Twine game[/url], this game was inspired by the poem of IntStories, [url=https://intstories.itch.io/the-elf-who-came-at-night]The Elf Who Came at Night[/url]. 

[Edited from Itch.io]
translation:
人类王子Aryan某晚被一名陌生访客口交时惊醒。

Aryan迫切渴望和男人发生性关系。他觉得自己愿意做任何事，只求能和另一个男人有一次亲密接触。可惜，由于王室身份，他一直没有机会体验。

一个吉祥的夜晚，他惊讶地发现自己是被人舔着龟头弄醒的。他睁开眼，看见那人是个男人……精灵？

王子早已习惯惊喜，但这次更是超乎想象——而他享受了整个过程。

本作最初是一款[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221206050601/https://gaywriter10.itch.io/nightly-visits-twine]Twine游戏[/url]，灵感来自IntStories的诗作[url=https://intstories.itch.io/the-elf-who-came-at-night]《夜访的精灵》[/url]。[改写自Itch.io]
